content: FDA topics most needing visual explanation: (1) Phase vs amplitude variation in registration — abstract concept that curves need to be 'aligned' before analysis; a before/after diagram is essential. (2) FPCA eigenfunctions — showing mean +/- component effect is the canonical visualization. (3) Basis representation — showing a function as weighted sum of basis elements. (4) Warping functions in elastic alignment — monotone function mapping. (5) Scalar-on-function coefficient surface β(t) — what the coefficient function means. (6) Depth/outlyingness — centrality ordering of curves, what a functional boxplot shows. (7) Control chart in SPM — Phase I/II, UCL/LCL, in-control vs out-of-control.
